title: Account recovery
lede: Bind Google or an email and password to your wallet. If you lose the wallet, sign in with them and move your profile to a new wallet.
truth_text: This does not recover your wallet's private key, or the tokens, USDC or prizes inside it. Ranked tickets and unclaimed prizes stay tied to the original wallet, because on-chain claims are bound to it. Only your off-chain profile moves: name, avatar, adventure level and quest completions.
unavailable: Account recovery is not available on this server right now.
methods_desc: Sign a message with your wallet to see and change the methods bound to it. Signing is free and moves no funds.
no_sign: This wallet cannot sign messages. Try Phantom or Solflare.
migrated_away: This wallet's account was moved to {wallet}. It can no longer bind methods.
google_not_configured: Google sign-in is not configured on this server.
recover_desc: Sign in with a method you bound earlier, then connect a new wallet and sign with it. Your profile moves to the new wallet. A second move is possible only 72 hours after the last one.
recover_connect: Now connect the NEW wallet you want to use.
recover_cooldown: Another move is possible in {hours} h.
recover_same: That is the same wallet. Connect a different one.
done_move: Profile moved to {wallet}. The old wallet is marked as moved.
email_notice: No email notice is sent when a move happens.
ok_google_bound: Google is now bound to this wallet.
ok_email_bound: Email is now bound to this wallet.
ok_recovery: Signed in with Google. Connect your new wallet below.
err_google_not_configured: Google sign-in is not configured on this server.
err_state: The Google sign-in expired or did not match. Start again.
err_google_failed: Google sign-in could not be verified.
err_email_unverified: That Google account's email is not verified.
err_taken: That sign-in is already bound to another wallet.
err_already_bound: This wallet already has that kind of method. Remove it first.
err_migrated: This wallet's account was already moved.
err_not_bound: That Google account is not bound to any wallet.
err_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in an hour.
err_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
err_password_common: That password is too easy to guess.
err_password_email: Do not put your email in the password.
err_cooldown: Moved too recently. Wait for the 72-hour cooldown.
err_refused: The profile cannot move to that wallet. It may already have its own sign-in methods.
err_bad_signature: The wallet signature did not check out. Try again.
err_recovery_session: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again.
err_unavailable: Account recovery is not available on this server right now.
lede_v2: Bind a passkey, recovery codes, or an email and password to your wallet. If you lose the wallet, sign in with one of them and move your game profile to a new wallet. Nothing here needs an outside service.
passkey_desc: Uses your phone, computer or password manager (fingerprint, face or PIN). Stays on your device.
passkey_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
codes_desc: 10 one-time codes to print or store offline. Each works once.
codes_once: Save these now. They are shown only once, and creating new ones cancels these.
code_wallet: Address of the wallet you lost
err_passkey_cancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled or timed out.
err_passkey_failed: The passkey could not be verified.
err_passkey_unknown: That passkey is not bound to any wallet.
err_passkey_expired: The passkey request expired. Try again.
err_bad_code: Wrong wallet address or recovery code, or the code was already used.
